risk_summary: The disclosure is quantitatively detailed regarding sales, operating results, backlog, surcharges, and specific cost pressures, but relies on qualified forward-looking language for geopolitical, inflationary, supply-chain, litigation, and cost-mitigation risks. Results improved year over year, although margins remain exposed to material, energy, transportation, labor, and asbestos-related uncertainties.
